summary: MP Meekail Ahmed Nasym (South Galolhu) proposed a resolution calling on the Government to publish all details of its agreement with UAE-based Eagle Hills for the 'Maldives Waterfront and Marina' project at Rasmalé, and asking MPs to state their view on the project. The resolution says the commercial terms have not been made public and lists concerns about the deal's terms for the State. Parliament voted it down on 26 October 2026.
keyPoints: The resolution says the Government and Eagle Hills signed the agreement on 21 September 2026 and its full details have not been disclosed.
It says 500 hectares of reclaimed Rasmalé land is to be given to Eagle Hills for 99 years, with no equity share or rent going to the State.
It says land reclaimed with public money would be handed over without the State recovering the reclamation cost.
It cites the Constitution's articles on state property (250), foreign ownership of territory (251) and the right to information (29).
Vote on 26 October 2026: 10 yes, 45 no, 0 abstentions, 19 present members did not vote.
